idea-plugin.name: GenericUI Project Creator & Target Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Official IntelliJ IDEA plugin for creating and managing GenericUI Kotlin Multiplatform projects.
  • New GenericUI Project Wizard: Interactive checkboxes for selecting all 9 target backends (windows, macos, gtk, qt, swing, android, ios, ipados, web) with quick presets (All Except Swing, Desktop Only (No Swing), Mobile Only, Apple Only, Select All), window defaults (alwaysOnTop, aspectRatio), Apple icon overrides, and :tests (JestElectricRunner) test scaffolding.
  • 19 Categorized First-Party Extension Modules: Select Graphics (gpu, imageProcessing, canvas2d, canvas3d, threeJs), Physics (box2d, box3d), Game & Input (gamepad, engine, engine2d, engine3d), Media (media, mediaControls), and UI (dsl, overlay, alien, webView, codeEditor, aiChat) with companion :dsl submodules and automatic transitive dependency resolution.
  • Manage GenericUI Targets & Extensions: Inspect and update an existing project's build.gradle.kts target backends, extension modules, window defaults, and Apple icons in-place.
